item.title: Version 1.3.0
item.description:
What's new

  • Automatic updates: TaskBoard now updates itself.
    • It checks for new versions daily; you can also use 任务看板 → 检查更新….
    • Updates are signed, and the app verifies each one before installing.
  • Reorder lists by dragging: grab the ≡ handle or the list title and drop it before or after another list. A blue bar shows where it will land.
  • Markdown descriptions:
    • Card descriptions render headings, lists, task lists, bold, italic, code, links, quotes and code blocks.
    • Double-click the description, or click 编辑, to edit it.
  • Auto-archive: in a board's gear menu (看板设置), done cards can archive themselves 1, 3, 7 or 30 days after completion.
  • Smoother interface:
    • Cards and lists animate as they move, appear and disappear.
    • Drop targets open up space while you drag, and cards lift slightly on hover.
    • With Reduce Motion turned on, movement is replaced by simple fades.
  • Faster boards: images load in the background, and only cards that actually changed are redrawn.

Upgrading

This is the first version with the built-in updater. If you're on 1.2.0 or earlier, install it manually once: replace the app in Applications. Later versions will arrive inside the app.

Your data upgrades automatically, and auto-archive stays off until you turn it on.

Install

  1. Download TaskBoard-1.3.0.dmg below, open it, and drag 任务看板 into Applications.
  2. The app isn't notarized by Apple, so the first launch is blocked. To allow it:
    • Go to System Settings → Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway.
    • Alternatively, run this in Terminal: 
      xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/任务看板.app"

Requirements: macOS 14 Sonoma or later. The DMG is a universal build for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
